lessons.trigger_condition: Tablet recovery reports seven edited Graphify, market, card/photo and integrity source files together.
lessons.prevention_rule: Archive both Git index and worktree versions of the complete reviewed set before installing official source; integrity_manifest.json is replaced source authority, never retained runtime data.
validation_required: Real Git simultaneous seven-path MM, staged-only and worktree-only installation
Backup corruption, preflight failure, exact merge rollback and symlink/unknown-path rejection
Private photos, last-good model and runtime JSON remain local and byte-preserved
Exact current-head successor lineage, integrity, Android and CI checks
lessons.safety_boundary: No arbitrary path or JSON wildcard, no source auto-reapplication, no image/model upload and no invented physical-device result.
